import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(breed_counts))
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_dist = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].unique(), key=lambda x: df[df['AlterVHundLang']==x]['AlterVHundSort'].iloc[0] if len(df[df['AlterVHundLang']==x]) > 0 else 0)
age_counts = [df[df['AlterVHundLang']==age].shape[0] for age in age_order if age in df['AlterVHundLang'].values]
age_labels = [age for age in age_order if age in df['AlterVHundLang'].values]
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts, color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_labels)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dog Gender Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sex_dist = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_sex = ['#FF9999', '#66B2FF']
ax3.pie(sex_dist.values, labels=sex_dist.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_sex)
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 4. Owner Gender Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
owner_sex = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
colors_owner = ['#99FF99', '#FFCC99']
ax4.pie(owner_sex.values, labels=owner_sex.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_owner)
ax4.set_title('Owner Gender Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 5. Dogs by District
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color='coral', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(district_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xlabel('District', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Dogs by District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Owner Age Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
owner_age = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts()
owner_age_sorted = owner_age.reindex(sorted(owner_age.index, key=lambda x: df[df['AlterV10Lang']==x]['AlterV10Sort'].iloc[0]))
colors_age = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 1, len(owner_age_sorted)))
owner_age_sorted.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=colors_age)
ax6.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Distribution of Dog Owners by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Trend over years
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='darkgreen')
ax7.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax7.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Dog Registration Data in Zurich', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
